svg.text: HUB 8735 ultra hand-built expansion board: solder side, wire layer 1 of 4
Seen from below (solder side): left and right are swapped. This layer's wires are in colour; the layers already soldered below it are pale grey, for orientation.
Hole names (letter + row) are as seen from the parts side. Numbers on the wires are the wire numbers of the wiring table, section 4.
battery sense, ADC test, ESC current filter
thick line = power or ground; thin line = signal
pale grey = lower layers, already soldered
order: layer 1 on the board, then 2, then 3; R24 last (4)
× = do not connect (D14 boot pin, LOG UART, D12, D13)
JP1 on: D2 reads the battery
JP3 on: D9 reads the ESC current
J6 powered: never plug in USB.
